title: Associate Regional Director
html:
We are seeking an Associate Regional Director (Internal Wholesaler) to drive advisor engagement and business development across the New York territory. Working in close partnership with an experienced External Wholesaler, this role focuses on building and owning advisor relationships, running virtual meetings, and driving net sales and cash flow within the territory.

The ideal candidate is a motivated, resilient communicator who thrives on high-volume outreach and genuinely enjoys building relationships. This is a sales-driven role with significant ownership, not administrative support, and a clear runway to External Wholesaler and other corporate opportunities.

This position offers the opportunity to grow a territory, deepen advisor partnerships, and build a long-term career with a growing asset management firm.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Partner with an External Wholesaler to develop, manage, and grow advisor relationships across the New York territory.
  • Own significant advisor relationships, serving as a key point of contact and running frequent virtual advisor meetings.
  • Drive high outbound activity to engage financial advisors, introduce products, and identify sales opportunities.
  • Execute territory planning and strategy in coordination with your External Wholesaler partner.
  • Support advisors with product knowledge, resources, and responsive service to deepen firm relationships.
  • Contribute to net cash flow and sales growth through consistent, proactive outreach and follow-up.
  • Maintain accurate records of advisor interactions and territory activity.
  • Travel as needed for advisor meetings and events (typically once per quarter).
  • Stay current on products, markets, and industry developments while adhering to regulatory and firm policies.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 2–5 years of experience in financial services (junior advisory, banking, client service, internal sales, or wholesaling backgrounds welcome).
  • Series 7 & 66 preferred upon hire, or willingness to obtain within the licensing window (licensing support provided).
  • Highly motivated sales personality: energetic, proactive, and resilient.
  • Comfortable with rejection and high outbound activity, with the thick skin the New York territory requires.
  • Strong communicator with a genuine desire to build relationships.
  • Team-oriented, working effectively alongside an External Wholesaler.

Compensation is competitive, with a base salary plus incentive structure. Monthly commission payouts, quarterly cash flow incentives, and strong upside for top performers.

title: Business Development Advisor
html:
Now Seeking: Business Development Advisor to join a growing wealth management firm in the Dallas-Fort Worth, TX area

The Business Development Advisor will serve as the first point of contact for prospective clients, focusing on outbound prospecting, lead development, and new client acquisition. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in a performance-driven environment and is motivated by developing relationships, generating opportunities, and contributing directly to the growth of a successful firm.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Develop and qualify prospective client relationships through outbound calling, networking, and follow-up with firm-generated leads
  • Execute a disciplined and consistent business development process focused on new client acquisition
  • Conduct discovery conversations with prospective clients to understand their needs and determine fit
  • Effectively communicate the firm's planning philosophy, service offering, team structure, and client experience
  • Manage the prospect journey from initial outreach through engagement and onboarding
  • Partner closely with advisors and team members to facilitate a seamless transition from prospect to client
  • Handle prospect objections professionally and confidently while maintaining a consultative approach
  • Maintain accurate records of prospect interactions, pipeline activity, and business development efforts within the CRM system
  • Monitor and track outreach activity, conversion metrics, and business development results
  • Participate in required training, licensing, continuing education, and professional development activities
  • Represent the firm with professionalism and integrity in all client and prospect interactions

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in a relevant field (economics, business, finance, marketing, communications, etc)
  • 1–5 years of experience in business development, sales, outbound prospecting, or relationship management
  • Financial services industry experience strongly preferred
  • Series 65 or Series 66 license preferred, or willingness to obtain within 90 days of hire
  • Demonstrated success meeting or exceeding business development, prospecting, or sales goals
  • Strong verbal communication and relationship-building skills
  • Ability to engage prospective clients, conduct discovery conversations, and build credibility quickly
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and follow-through
  • Experience utilizing CRM systems to manage pipeline activity and prospect relationships
  • Self-motivated with the ability to work independently in a goal-oriented environment
  • Clean U4 and U5 record required for licensed candidates

Actual base pay may vary based on factors including, but not limited to: experience, geographic location, licensing, and overall qualifications. The base pay is just one component of the total compensation package. Additional compensation may include performance-based incentives, bonus opportunities, and a comprehensive benefits package. Please note that the job title may be adjusted based on the selected candidate's experience and qualifications.

title: Client Relationship Specialist
html:
We are seeking an experienced Client Relationship Specialist who is passionate about delivering an exceptional client experience while supporting financial advisors in a collaborative, planning-focused wealth management environment.

This position is ideal for a service-oriented professional who enjoys building lasting client relationships, coordinating complex client service activities, and ensuring every interaction is handled with professionalism, accuracy, and care.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a growing independent fiduciary advisory firm where you'll work alongside experienced advisors and specialists while gaining exposure to comprehensive financial planning, investment management, and high-net-worth client relationships. The firm is committed to investing in employee development and offers opportunities to pursue professional designations and long-term career growth.

This is a full-time, in-office position based in Franklin, Tennessee.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for clients, providing responsive, high-touch service by phone, email, and in person.
  • Prepare for and follow up on client meetings by coordinating reports, investment updates, paperwork, and action items.
  • Assist with account openings, investment paperwork, money movement requests, account maintenance, and client reporting.
  • Execute investment trades at the direction of financial advisors while ensuring accuracy and compliance.
  • Guide clients through the firm's client portal and assist with general account and service-related questions.
  • Maintain advisor calendars, coordinate client meetings, and manage deadlines to ensure an organized and efficient workflow.
  • Keep client records, documentation, and CRM data accurate and up to date.
  • Support client appreciation events, educational seminars, and other firm-sponsored activities.
  • Collaborate closely with advisors and internal team members to deliver a seamless client experience.
  • Maintain confidentiality while handling sensitive client information with professionalism and discretion.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of experience in financial services, preferably within a wealth management or independent RIA environment.
  • Series 65 license preferred or willingness to obtain.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred but not required.
  • Strong client service, communication, and relationship management skills.
  • Excellent organizational skills with the ability to manage multiple priorities while maintaining exceptional attention to detail.
  • Proficiency with Microsoft Office applications required.
  • Experience with CRM and wealth management technology platforms such as Orion, Redtail, or similar systems preferred.
  • Comfortable working with affluent individuals and families in a high-touch service environment.
  • Demonstrated professionalism, sound judgment, and the ability to build long-term client relationships.
  • Self-motivated, dependable, and committed to contributing to a collaborative team culture.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Compensation includes a competitive base salary beginning at $65,000+ commensurate with experience, plus bonus eligibility.

The firm offers a comprehensive benefits package including medical and dental insurance, paid time off, volunteer time off, a 401(k) plan with employer matching, financial wellness resources, tuition reimbursement, and ongoing opportunities for professional growth and career development.

title: Client Service Associate
html:
We are seeking a detail-oriented and client-focused Client Service Associate to deliver comprehensive wealth management services to UHNW families.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Organize and prepare materials for regular client meetings
  • Attend and participate in client meetings, prepare follow-up letters and action lists
  • Monitor and implement client-agreed action items, working directly with clients to ensure proper execution of all investment documents
  • Review quarterly client reporting and participate in calls to review the materials
  • Assist in developing and implementing customized asset allocation and wealth transfer strategies
  • Collaborate with clients' outsourced tax, legal, and other experts to facilitate planning goals
  • Assist in preparing new business development presentations as needed
  • Participate in other internal firm initiatives

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in financial services or relevant field
  • Minimum 3 years of experience in financial services, tax, family office, or investment with high net-worth families
  • CFP, CPA or MBA a plus
  • Strong commitment to providing exceptional client service in a team-oriented environment
  • Consistently high attention to detail, accuracy, and thoroughness
  • Strong analytical skills
  • Outstanding written and oral communication skills
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel

The total compensation package includes a competitive base salary and bonus opportunity, structured to reflect the candidate’s prior experience, demonstrated impact, and future growth potential.

title: Client Services Associate
html:
We are seeking an experienced Client Service Associate who wants to deliver a white-glove client experience and serve as a relationship manager for complex client and operational workflows.

This position is ideal for a service-oriented professional who thrives in a fast-paced environment supporting UHNW families and managing intricate client relationships, and offers opportunities to those who want to work alongside experienced advisors, investment professionals, and family office specialists that serve a variety of clients, such as entrepreneurs, executives, multi-generational families and non-profit organizations.

This is a full-time, in-office position based in Carmel, Indiana.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES
  • Serve as a trusted point of contact for clients, delivering high-touch service experience and cultivating long-term relationships with clients and strategic partners.
  • Manage day-to-day client service activities with a strong emphasis on accuracy, responsiveness, compliance, and attention to detail.
  • Lead complex client onboarding initiatives, coordinating with custodians, trust companies, transfer agents, investment managers, and other third parties to facilitate account openings, transfers, and ongoing administration.
  • Support sophisticated investment and family office workflows, including coordination with alternative investment managers, private equity firms, custodians, and other external providers.
  • Assist clients with liquidity events, distributions, cash management requests, and other specialized wealth management activities.
  • Partner with advisors, the investment team, and leadership to ensure a seamless and highly personalized client experience.
  • Leverage firm technology platforms and reporting systems to maintain data integrity, enhance workflows, and support operational efficiencies.
  • Contribute to process improvement initiatives and help establish scalable best practices across the organization.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to support strategic projects, client initiatives, and the continued growth of the firm.
QUALIFICATIONS
  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • 2+ years of experience in client service, wealth management operations, or a similar role within an RIA, multi-family office, or single-family office environment.
  • Experience supporting high-net-worth or ultra-high-net-worth clients preferred.
  • Broad understanding of investment products, mutual funds, custodial platforms, and brokerage account administration.
  • Experience coordinating account openings, transfers, money movements, and client servicing workflows.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications required.
  • Familiarity with CRM systems, including Salesforce, preferred.
  • Highly organized with exceptional attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Strong communication skills with the ability to build rapport, demonstrate empathy, and maintain discretion when working with clients and colleagues.
  • Self-motivated, proactive, and committed to delivering exceptional client experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to work collaboratively within a team-oriented environment while taking ownership of responsibilities and initiatives.
COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Compensation is competitive and based on experience. The role offers a base salary plus discretionary bonus, with anticipated base compensation beginning at $70,000+ and may be adjusted based on qualifications and relevant experience. The firm offers a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision coverage, a 401(k) plan with employer match, professional development reimbursement, unlimited paid time off, and additional employee benefits.

title: Director of Retirement Plans
html:
We are seeking a Director of Retirement Plans to lead an established retirement plan platform within a growing wealth management organization. This leadership opportunity offers the ability to guide a highly regarded business, support meaningful client relationships, and contribute to the continued evolution of a key service offering for commercial clients and prospects.

The ideal candidate is an experienced retirement plan professional and leader who combines deep technical expertise with strong relationship management skills, a collaborative mindset, and a passion for developing teams and enhancing client outcomes.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as a senior relationship lead for retirement plan clients, providing consultative guidance to plan sponsors and investment committees.
  • Deliver a consistent, high-touch fiduciary experience while supporting clients in achieving their long-term retirement plan objectives.
  • Partner closely with both banking and private wealth teams to support the delivery of retirement plan solutions and strengthen existing referral relationships.
  • Participate in client and prospect conversations alongside internal partners, providing subject matter expertise and strategic insight.
  • Identify opportunities to deepen existing client relationships and expand services where aligned with client needs and organizational objectives.
  • Lead, coach, and develop a team of retirement plan professionals, fostering a collaborative, service-oriented, and accountable culture.
  • Support succession planning efforts, talent development initiatives, and the recruitment and onboarding of new team members as the business evolves.
  • Manage relationships with recordkeepers, vendors, and strategic partners to ensure operational efficiency and a high-quality client experience.
  • Maintain strong governance, compliance, and fiduciary oversight practices, ensuring adherence to ERISA requirements and industry best practices.
  • Contribute to the ongoing enhancement of the retirement plan platform, evaluating opportunities to strengthen capabilities and adapt to changing client needs.
  • Stay informed on industry trends, regulatory developments, retirement plan strategies, and market conditions to support clients and internal stakeholders effectively.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, or a related field.
  • 10+ years of experience within retirement plan services, wealth management, or institutional consulting.
  • Demonstrated leadership experience, including coaching, managing, and developing teams.
  • Broad experience across retirement plan consulting, client service, plan design, and relationship management.
  • Strong understanding of ERISA regulations, fiduciary responsibilities, and retirement plan best practices.
  • Effective interpersonal skills with the ability to build relationships with clients, prospects, and internal partners.
  • Excellent verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present complex concepts clearly and confidently.
  • Working knowledge of portfolio management principles, financial markets, and financial planning concepts.
  • Experience participating in or supporting client and prospective client discussions.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with commercial banking, wealth management, and other internal business partners.
  • Professional designations such as CFP, CWS, or similar credentials are preferred but not required.
  • FINRA licenses (Series 7, 65, or 66) are not required but may enhance success within the role.
  • Willingness to travel as needed throughout Wisconsin to support client relationships and internal partnerships.

Compensation is competitive and based on experience. A comprehensive benefits package includes medical, dental, and vision coverage, paid time off, parental leave, 401(k) participation with company contributions, profit sharing, professional development opportunities, wellness initiatives, and additional employee benefits.

title: Estate & Wealth Planning Specialist
html:
We are seeking a dedicated and analytical Estate & Wealth Planning Specialist to serve as the technical subject matter expert on all aspects of estate, gift, and wealth transfer planning for a partner firm in Chicago.

This role focuses on reviewing complex estate planning documents, designing sophisticated gifting and wealth transfer strategies, and guiding high-net-worth clients through estate administration and tax compliance. It offers the opportunity to shape multi-generational wealth strategies while partnering with advisory teams to deliver a unified, holistic client experience.

The ideal candidate has a deep technical understanding of tax laws and wealth preservation strategies. While Juris Doctor (JD)/Attorney candidates are strongly preferred to facilitate potential document drafting, we will also strongly consider highly specialized CPAs with extensive experience in estate and trust taxation.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Review, analyze, and interpret complex estate planning documents—including wills, revocable/irrevocable trusts, powers of attorney, and healthcare directives—to align client portfolios with legal intentions.
  • Design, model, and implement sophisticated gifting strategies (e.g., GRATs, IDGTs, ILITs, CLTs/CRTs, and annual exclusion gifting) to minimize tax exposure and maximize wealth transfer across generations.
  • Prepare and review federal and state gift tax returns (Form 709), estate tax returns (Form 706), and estate and trust income tax returns (Form 1041), ensuring strict compliance with current tax codes.
  • Guide clients through the estate administration process, managing post-mortem tax planning, asset valuations, and state/federal tax filings.
  • Build clear, comprehensive estate planning schematics and cash-flow flowcharts to illustrate complex multi-generational structures for clients.
  • Audit and advise clients on proper asset titling and beneficiary designations to ensure seamless probate avoidance and alignment with overall estate plans.
  • Partner closely with internal consultants and advisory teams to deliver a unified, holistic wealth management experience for high-net-worth clients.
  • Stay current on federal and state tax developments, planning strategies, and industry best practices while ensuring adherence to regulatory and firm policies.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Juris Doctor (JD) with active bar admission in good standing preferred; LL.M. in Taxation or Estate Planning is a strong plus.
    • Alternatively, Certified Public Accountant (CPA) with a specialized focus in estate, trust, and gift taxation would also be accepted.
  • 3–5+ years of dedicated professional experience in estate planning, trust administration, and tax preparation within a law firm, CPA firm, or wealth management practice.
  • Comprehensive understanding of federal estate, gift, and generation-skipping transfer (GST) tax laws, as well as fiduciary accounting principles.
  • Exceptional verbal and written communication skills, with the proven ability to translate complex legal and tax concepts into clear, actionable advice for high-net-worth clients.
  • Meticulous analytical skills with a high degree of accuracy in tax return preparation, document review, and estate modeling.

COMPENSATION
Salary commensurate with experience. Midlevel experience (3-6 years) can expect healthy salary ranges beginning at $110,000. Senior/Management Level (6+ years) are invited to apply, and salary will reflect experience.

title: Planning Strategist
html:
We are seeking a Client Relationship Specialist to help our senior advisors take excellent care of their clients. In this role, you'll be one of the people clients come to know and trust by coordinating details, following up on next steps, preparing for meetings, and keeping important work moving so clients feel cared for and advisors have the support they need.

This is a strong fit for someone who is organized, warm, and steady under pressure, with real room to grow.
New business development is handled separately, so you can focus entirely on client care and advisor support. You'll be the connecting thread between advisors and clients; the person keeping things moving so advisors can focus on planning and clients always feel taken care of.

Our client is a growing, independent RIA focused on high-net-worth clients, offering exposure to sophisticated financial planning, investment management, and firm operations while working closely with advisors genuinely invested in your growth.

Open positions in Colorado Springs, CO; Phoenix, AZ; and Nashville, TN (in office).

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Prepare for and follow up on client meetings—investment and planning updates, reports, paperwork, and next steps.
  • Serve as a go-to point of contact for clients by phone, email, and in person, including help with the client portal.
  • Handle account opening, investment paperwork, money movement requests, and reporting; place trades at an advisor's direction.
  • Keep advisor calendars, deadlines, and client records organized and on track.
  • Support client and prospect events, approved educational content, and day-to-day office needs.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 3+ years of experience in financial services, ideally in wealth management or the independent RIA space.
  • Series 65 license preferred, or willingness to obtain.
  • Bachelor's degree preferred, but not required.
  • Strong client service, communication, and relationship management skills.
  • Sharp attention to detail and follow-through, with comfort managing multiple systems and priorities.
  • Solid Microsoft Office skills; CRM experience (Orion, Redtail) is a plus.
  • Client-facing experience and comfort working directly with affluent individuals and families.
  • A track record of sticking with roles and growing within them.

GROWTH OPPORTUNITIES AVAILABLE

  • Toward financial planning: support in pursuing the CFP or FPQP designation, with opportunities to contribute to client financial plans.
  • Toward deeper client service: the opportunity to work more closely with the firm's highest-net-worth clients through family office services.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Compensation based on experience, beginning at $70,000. Bonus eligible. Benefits include health insurance, dental, PTO, VTO, financial wellness, 401(k) with company matching, and tuition reimbursement.

title: Regional VP/Wealth Management Consultant
html:
The Regional VP/Wealth Management Consultant role is responsible for nurturing and expanding referral partnerships, working alongside Advisors to cultivate new client relationships, and ensuring new business success in their assigned sales region.

This role requires relationship management, communication, leadership skills, and excellent analytical and problem-solving abilities to ensure optimal client outcomes.

While this position is headquartered in Dallas or Houston, TX, advisors within the New England region are prioritized. Travel required throughout your region (50-75%).

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the primary point of contact for external referral partners within the assigned sales region.
  • Build rapport and establish trust with external partners to create a robust pipeline of new business opportunities.
  • Effectively communicate the firm’s value proposition and ideal client persona.
  • Present at regional events and meetings, serving as the ultimate ambassador for the services and value provided.
  • Understand the regional advisor’s expertise and growth goals to connect them with the right prospective clients.
  • Engage with prospective clients to identify their needs and facilitate communication with the assigned advisor.
  • Support the creation of client deliverables, including financial planning, investments, and estate/tax advice.
  • Maintain in-depth knowledge of service offerings and solutions.
  • Guide prospective clients through the sales cycle, ensuring a smooth transition and onboarding.
  • Foster a positive work environment, demonstrating the organization’s guiding principles.
  • Contribute to continuous market growth and achievement of regional goals.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in finance, financial planning, or a related field.
  • 5+ years of successful sales experience in financial services or related industry.
  • CFP, ChFC, PFS, CFA or CIC credential(s) preferred.
  • Series 65 or a combination of Series 7 and Series 66 licenses required.
  • Strong knowledge of financial planning and investment management.
  • Familiarity with Salesforce or similar CRM systems a plus.
  • Superior relationship management, communication, and presentation skills.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills in a fast-paced environment.
  • Excellent analytical and problem-solving skills
    Must maintain compliance with all regulations and policies, including a clean U4 and solid registration history.

title: RVP - Lead Advisor, New Client Development
html:
Lead Advisor, New Client Development

Our client is a privately held, multi-billion-dollar independent RIA seeking an experienced financial professional to lead new client acquisition across an assigned region. This is a pure sales role with qualified lead flow provided. No cold calling.

As a Lead Advisor, you will present their investment and planning solutions to high-net-worth prospects, guide the full sales cycle, and convert qualified leads into long-term advisory relationships while supported by internal sales, marketing, client services, and planning teams.

Responsibilities

  • Engage prospective clients to understand their financial situation and identify the right solutions
  • Present comprehensive wealth management proposals covering financial planning, investments, tax, and estate considerations
  • Partner with local advisors to match prospects to the right expertise and ensure a seamless onboarding experience
  • Guide prospects through the full sales cycle with urgency and professionalism
  • Maintain high-volume activity across phone, virtual, and in-person meetings within your territory

Qualifications

  • 5+ years of client-facing experience in wealth management or financial planning
  • 3+ years of demonstrated success closing new business with high-net-worth clients
  • CFP, ChFC, or equivalent designation preferred
  • FINRA Series 65, or Series 7 and 63/66; Life insurance license required or willingness to obtain
  • Bachelor's degree preferred
  • Strong communication, presentation, and analytical skills
  • Comfortable with planning and CRM technology; experience with MoneyGuidePro, Salesforce, or Tamarac a plus
  • Self-starter who can manage a remote territory independently

title: Senior Wealth Advisor
html:
We are seeking an experienced Senior Wealth Advisor to provide comprehensive wealth management advice and build long-term relationships with high-net-worth clients.
This role partners closely with individuals and families to develop personalized financial strategies and help clients make the most informed decisions related to their wealth.

Our client is one of the nation's largest and most successful RIA firms that offers an industry-leading strategic platform that brings together holistic financial planning, access to institutional-quality investments, life and legacy planning, and impact initiatives for clients. With centralized back-office services, resources, and technology, the platform is delivered and supported by a team of experts acting as an extension of the advisor's practice. Access to leading custodian retail referral programs provides an opportunity for enhanced lead flow and growth.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and manage a book of business by developing strong client relationships and providing a best-in-class client experience.
  • Deliver sophisticated financial planning and investment advice tailored to client goals and objectives, adjusting strategies as client needs evolve.
  • Collaborate with internal specialists to deliver integrated, holistic solutions.
  • Identify and pursue new business opportunities through referrals, networking, and strategic outreach.
  • Stay current on financial markets, planning strategies, and industry developments while ensuring adherence to regulatory and firm policies.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience as a Financial Advisor or Wealth Advisor.
  • Proven track record of client acquisition and asset growth.
  • Background in a wirehouse, independent broker-dealer, bank, or RIA environment.
  • Financial planning experience preferred.
  • CFP, CFA, or other professional designations preferred.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or related field preferred.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication, organizational, and interpersonal skills, with the ability to work as part of a team while being a self-starter.
  • Outgoing, sales-minded, self-motivated, and multi-faceted, with a drive to help grow the business.

COMPENSATION

Compensation is competitive and based on experience, with range beginning at $125,000 annually.

title: Senior Wealth Planning Strategist
html:
We are searching for a Senior Wealth Planning Strategist for a fast-growing wealth management firm that serves entrepreneurs, business owners, and multigenerational wealthy families across Michigan and nationally. This firm has build its reputation on team-based, comprehensive planning while helping clients navigate major liquidity events, business succession, and the transition from one wealth engine to the next.

This newly created role would serve as the firm's dedicated subject matter expert on advanced estate and tax planning for its highest net worth relationships. The Strategist will work directly alongside the firm's advisors (not as an advisor themself) as a trusted resource for advisors and clients to turn to for sophisticated estate, gift, and tax strategy.

This is not an administrative or purely technical back-office role. It is a high-visibility seat with direct client exposure, meaningful influence over how the firm delivers planning, and a clear path to grow alongside a firm that has sustained 20%+ organic growth annually.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the firm's subject matter expert on advanced estate planning, wealth transfer, and tax strategy for high-net-worth and ultra-high-net-worth clients, including a core group of relationships with $100 million+ in assets.
  • Partner closely with the firm's advisors to develop and deliver custom, sophisticated estate and financial plans and step into relationships at the point where planning expertise adds the most value, whether at intake, mid-relationship, or as a closer on a new prospect.
  • Support broader tax planning beyond estate strategy, including current and ordinary income tax mitigation strategies for clients with complex tax situations.
  • Build genuine, durable relationships with the firm's advisors and their clients. This role is expected to spend meaningful time in-office building trust and familiarity with the team before working more independently or remotely.
  • Participate in client and prospect meetings (in person and via Zoom) alongside advisors, translating complex estate and tax concepts into clear, actionable guidance.
  • Act as a resource across the entire advisory team, with the largest share of time spent supporting the firm's senior advisor/partner, and additional support to several other advisors firmwide.
  • Maintain command of current estate, gift, and tax law and proactively identify planning opportunities for clients as regulations and circumstances change.
  • Contribute to a collaborative, values-driven culture — this role is expected to align with and reinforce the firm's operating principles, not simply bring an outside playbook.
  • Travel periodically (roughly once per quarter, sometimes more) to meet with clients located outside Michigan.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 10+ years of experience in estate planning, tax planning, or wealth strategy for high-net-worth or ultra-high-net-worth clients.
  • JD, CPA, and/or LLM/Master's in Taxation strongly preferred; candidates with a JD and CPA, or JD with an LLM in Tax, are especially of interest.
  • Background from a law firm, CPA/accounting firm, bank trust department, or another RIA/wealth management firm in an estate strategist, wealth strategist, or planning specialist capacity — candidates need not come from a wirehouse or traditional advisory seat.
  • Demonstrated experience advising business owners and multigenerational families, ideally including work tied to business sales, succession, or liquidity events.
  • A collaborative, low-ego style. This person will be a resource to advisors and clients, not a standalone rainmaker, and needs to embrace a team-based planning culture rather than operate independently of it.
  • Strong presence and communication skills; the firm is open to candidates earlier in the 10+ year range as well as more seasoned professionals, provided they bring maturity, gravitas, and genuine client-facing polish.
  • Willingness to be based in or relocate to West Michigan (Grand Rapids preferred, Birmingham considered), with meaningful in-office presence, especially in the first several months.

title: Service Advisor
html:
The Service Advisor is a licensed financial professional responsible for supporting the advisory team in delivering financial planning and investment advice. This role involves direct interaction with clients to implement advisor-directed strategies, prepare financial plans, and provide ongoing service. While this role may not fully own client relationships or new business development, it operates with a degree of independent judgment and applies specialized financial knowledge.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Prepare and deliver comprehensive financial plans in collaboration with lead advisors.
  • Implement investment strategies and process account transactions as needed.
  • Serve as a point of contact for existing clients for service-related needs.
  • Analyze client data to identify financial planning opportunities.
  • Ensure timely and accurate execution of client requests.
  • Maintain detailed documentation in CRM and financial planning systems.
  • Stay current with industry regulations, market trends, and product knowledge.
  • Support advisors in client retention and satisfaction initiatives.

*Please note the role will vary, grow and change and is not limited to the items above.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Business, or related field.
  • Active Series 65 license, Series 66 license, CFP designation, CFA designation, ChFC designation, or CIC designation required.
  • Strong knowledge of financial planning concepts, investments, and regulatory requirements.
  • Excellent communication and client service skills
  • Demonstrate excellent oral, written, and interpersonal communication skills
  • Possess a willingness to learn firm technologies

Salary + Benefits:

  • Competitive, based on experience
  • Medical Insurance
  • Dental/Vision Insurance
  • Life & Personal Accident Insurance
  • Short-term Disability Insurance
  • Long-term Disability Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA), Health Savings Account (HSA) or Dependent Care FSA
  • 401(k) Plan with company matching
  • Paid Time Off (PTO) and paid holidays

title: Service Advisor
html:
We are seeking a relationship-driven Service Advisor to join a team-oriented firm in Issaquah, WA. This role offers the opportunity to inherit and grow an established client base and needs to excel in delivering high-touch service to clients.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Act as a high-level relationship manager, supporting clients in collaboration with the regional lead and senior advisors.
  • Inherit and manage an overflow book of business, assisting with up to $40-50M in additional AUM.
  • Provide direct client support, including onboarding, maintaining financial plans, and monitoring transfers through custodians.
  • Engage in client meetings (50% virtual, 50% in-person) with a focus on customized financial planning and investment management.
  • Partner with operations staff to improve processes and enhance efficiencies, providing additional support in areas such as account maintenance and administrative tasks.
  • Collaborate with other team members to build long-term client relationships and grow the firm through referrals and proactive outreach.
  • Leverage tools like eMoney for financial planning and manage workflows efficiently and effectively to ensure client satisfaction.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in Finance, Economics, or a similar field.
  • Minimum 3-7 years experience in Wealth Management, Financial Advising, or similar.
  • Proficiency with financial planning software (e.g. eMoney) and custodial platforms (e.g. Fidelity, Schwab, etc)
  • A collaborative, team-focused mindset with excellent communication and relationship-building skills
  • Driven, proactive, and motivated to grow professionally.
  • Ability to work on-site in Issaquah, with proximity to Seattle. Flexibility in work location available pending performance and tenure.

title: Servicing Wealth Advisor
html:
We are seeking an experienced Servicing Wealth Advisor to join a highly specialized and growing wealth management practice serving airline professionals and their families.

This opportunity offers the ability to step into an established client base, deliver sophisticated planning solutions, and play a meaningful role in the long-term evolution of the firm.

This is a client service and relationship management role rather than business development. The successful candidate will inherit existing relationships, support incoming clients, and provide ongoing planning guidance, while having the opportunity to participate in business development initiatives over time if desired.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as the lead advisor for existing client relationships, delivering a high-touch and highly personalized client experience.
  • Develop and maintain long-term relationships with high-net-worth individuals and families, serving as a trusted advisor across multiple areas of planning.
  • Provide comprehensive financial planning advice, including retirement planning, tax strategies, estate planning, Medicare and insurance planning, and wealth transfer considerations.
  • Collaborate with clients to develop customized financial plans designed to support long-term objectives and evolving needs.
  • Deliver fiduciary advice and long-term investment guidance, emphasizing strategic asset allocation and comprehensive wealth management.
  • Support the onboarding of new client relationships and ensure a seamless transition into the firm's planning process.
  • Partner with internal resources and subject matter experts to provide coordinated advice and exceptional client service.
  • Identify opportunities to deepen existing client relationships through additional planning services and expanded engagement where appropriate.
  • Contribute to the continued growth and development of the practice, including participation in prospective client discussions and relationship-building efforts as desired.
  • Remain current on industry trends, financial planning strategies, tax considerations, and regulatory developments to ensure best-in-class client advice.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in business, finance, economics, or a related field.
  • CFP designation required. Additional professional designations such as EA, CPA, AEP, ChFC, or similar credentials are highly desirable.
  • 7–10 years of experience within wealth management, financial planning, or advisory services.
  • Demonstrated experience serving high-net-worth individuals and families.
  • Strong planning orientation with expertise across retirement income planning, estate planning, tax strategies, insurance planning, and wealth transfer concepts.
  • Experience leading client relationships and delivering comprehensive financial planning recommendations.
  • Excellent communication, relationship management, and interpersonal skills.
  • Self-motivated, entrepreneurial mindset with the ability to work independently and thrive within a less structured environment.
  • Commitment to fiduciary advice, client education, and long-term relationship development.

This opportunity may appeal to experienced Associate Wealth Advisors, Senior Wealth Advisors, Lead Advisors, or CFP professionals seeking greater autonomy, leadership opportunities, and a clearer succession path.

Candidates who enjoy serving clients, delivering sophisticated planning advice, and building meaningful long-term relationships without a heavy emphasis on sales activity will find this role particularly attractive.

COMPENSATION

Compensation is based on experience, consisting of base salary and incentive compensation, with the ability to increase as responsibilities and relationships expand.

Long-term incentives may include profit sharing, phantom equity, employee ownership opportunities, partnership potential, or other forms of equity participation.

title: UHNW Wealth Advisor
html:
We are seeking a UHNW Wealth Advisor to join a growing wealth management team in the Dallas market.

The position focuses on relationship management, financial planning, investment discussions, and ongoing client service within a sophisticated family office environment.

The ideal candidate is polished, client-facing, and comfortable navigating complex wealth management conversations while working collaboratively alongside experienced advisory teams.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Support senior advisors in the ongoing management of ultra-high-net-worth client relationships and financial planning initiatives.
  • Participate in client meetings and assist with the delivery of investment and wealth management strategies.
  • Prepare client meeting presentations, planning analyses, and reporting materials.
  • Communicate sophisticated investment and financial planning concepts in a clear, concise, and client-friendly manner.
  • Serve as a point of contact for UHNW client relationships, responding to inquiries and coordinating requests in a timely and professional manner.
  • Assist in overseeing client investment and financial plans, including coordination across planning and reporting needs.
  • Collaborate with advisory and client service teams to ensure a seamless and high-touch client experience.
  • Support business development initiatives and relationship expansion opportunities within existing client networks.
  • Contribute to internal process improvement efforts and operational efficiencies to enhance team effectiveness and client service delivery.
  • Maintain awareness of financial markets, planning strategies, and industry developments while adhering to firm policies and compliance requirements.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree required; CFP or CFA designation strongly preferred.
  • 5–7 years of experience within wealth management, investment advisory, family office, estate planning, or related financial services environments.
  • Strong understanding of investment management and holistic financial planning concepts.
  • Polished communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to interact confidently with ultra-high-net-worth clients and families.
  • Highly organized with strong attention to detail and the ability to manage multiple priorities effectively.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.
  • Self-motivated with the ability to thrive in a collaborative and entrepreneurial environment.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office applications including Word, Excel, PowerPoint, and Outlook.
  • Experience with CRM and financial planning software preferred.
  • Willingness to travel periodically for client meetings.

Compensation is highly competitive and based on experience.

title: VP, M&A Business Development
html:
Our client is seeking a Vice President, M&A Business Development.
The VP is primarily focused on new business origination but may also manage and execute certain investment banking or consulting projects. The VP will become a trusted advisor to prospects and clients by developing relationships and becoming an expert in all of the firm's products and services, with a focus on personal branding through networking, speaking engagements, and authoring articles for industry publications.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Generate new business across all products and services nationally to achieve new business goals.
  • Develop prospect and client relationships that drive value for clients and lead to future business.
  • Identify issues affecting clients and prospects and develop strategies to effectively resolve them.
  • Manage and execute client projects—such as strategic planning, perpetuation planning, M&A transactions, due diligence, and valuations—or identify appropriate team members to fulfill them.
  • Regularly attend sales meetings and complete business plans as directed by Sales Leadership.
  • Collaborate with leaders and consultants across the company to understand their lines of business and initiate new business opportunities.
  • Develop deep, trusted relationships with clients and team leaders to ensure client retention, providing a high level of service and proactively offering additional consulting solutions.
  • Keep the CRM up to date with current and prospective account, client, and opportunity information, and provide pipeline updates at sales meetings.
  • Assist with the development of marketing strategies and materials that align with service delivery strategies, and support external and internal branding execution.
  • Publish articles and deliver presentations on timely topics affecting the insurance and wealth management industries.
  • Stay abreast of industry news, trends, and changes, incorporating proven practices into the development of services, quality standards, policies, and programs.
  • Cultivate and maintain effective relationships with internal and external clients, partners, and stakeholders that can directly or indirectly lead to revenue generation.
  • Support special projects and other tasks as assigned.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Business Management, Finance, or a related field; Master's degree is a plus.
  • Related professional designations and licenses preferred.
  • 10+ years of business development leadership experience with a proven track record of achieving sales goals.
  • Experience in financial services, insurance, consulting, or professional services industries; financial consulting, M&A advisory, or wealth management experience is desired.
  • Formal sales training (Challenger, Sandler, Wilson, IMPAX, or equivalent) preferred.
  • Proficiency in Microsoft Office (Word, Excel, Access, PowerPoint) and Salesforce; Salesforce experience preferred.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, with demonstrated creativity in work product.
  • Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to identify and resolve issues in a timely manner.
  • Ability to travel 50–60% of the time, including overnight and weekend travel, and to work flexible or extended hours as needed.

COMPENSATION

Compensation is competitive and based on experience.

title: Wealth Advisor
html:
We are seeking an experienced Wealth Advisor to provide comprehensive financial planning and tailored investment solutions within a personalized, concierge client experience. This role partners closely with high-net-worth individuals, families, executives, business owners, and retirees to develop and implement customized strategies that help clients achieve their long-term goals.

Our client is a boutique, employee-owned, fee-based Registered Investment Adviser serving clients in Kansas City, built on a philosophy of expertise and objectivity. As a fiduciary firm, the advisor's success is measured by client outcomes delivered through holistic financial planning, investment management, estate planning, tax strategies, and risk management, supported by a passionate team that treats the client relationship as the firm's most important asset.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as a trusted advisor to high-net-worth individuals and families, delivering holistic financial planning, investment management, estate planning, and tax-efficient strategies tailored to each client's goals.
  • Build and manage client relationships, providing direct, concierge-level access and a consistently exceptional client experience.
  • Develop and implement customized financial plans, adjusting strategies as client needs and life goals evolve.
  • Collaborate with the firm's team of planning, investment, tax, and estate specialists to deliver integrated, objective solutions.
  • Cultivate new client relationships through referrals, centers of influence, and professional partnerships.
  • Stay current on financial markets, planning strategies, and regulatory developments while upholding the firm's fiduciary standard.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Economics, Accounting, or a related field.
  • CFP, CFA, CPWA, or similar designation preferred, or a willingness to pursue.
  • 5+ years of experience in wealth management, financial planning, or investment management.
  • Proven ability to develop and retain high-net-worth client relationships.
  • Strong communication, interpersonal, and relationship-management skills, with a client-first, fiduciary mindset.
  • FINRA Series 65, or ability to obtain within six months of hire.
  • Collaborative team orientation balanced with self-motivation and an entrepreneurial approach to growth.

COMPENSATION

  • Compensation is competitive and based on experience.

title: Wealth Advisor
html:
We are seeking a hungry, entrepreneurial Wealth Advisor to join a boutique wealth management practice and take excellent care of clients while helping grow the business. This is a client-facing role for an advisor who can build and manage relationships, deliver sophisticated planning, and bring in new business. The right attitude and drive mattering as much as years of experience.

Our client is a small, close-knit firm serving mass-affluent and high-net-worth clients. The firm provides full support, including operations, service, and infrastructure, so advisors can focus on clients and growth. This is a strong fit for a self-starter who wants room to build their own book while being backed by a firm that covers the overhead.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Build and manage client relationships, providing a high level of personalized service and attention.
  • Deliver comprehensive financial planning and investment advice tailored to each client's goals, adjusting strategies as needs evolve.
  • Develop new business through referrals, networking, and strategic outreach, contributing directly to the firm's growth.
  • Serve mass-affluent and high-net-worth clients, typically in the $600K–$2M asset range, with proactive, attentive care.
  • Collaborate with the firm's support team to ensure seamless service and client experience.
  • Stay current on financial markets, planning strategies, and industry developments while ensuring adherence to regulatory and firm policies.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Transferrable book of assets, minimum $25mm.
  • Experience in wealth management, financial planning, or investment advisory, with a client-facing background.
  • Demonstrated ability—or clear potential—to develop new business and build a book of clients.
  • Strong communication, relationship-building, and interpersonal skills.
  • Entrepreneurial, self-motivated, and hungry, with a genuine commitment to taking care of clients.
  • FINRA Series 65 (or Series 7 and 66), or willingness to obtain.

COMPENSATION

Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience, starting at $125,000, with a transition to a revenue-grid payout as the book grows. The firm covers overhead and provides full operational support.

title: Wealth Advisor
html:
We are seeking an experienced Wealth Management Advisor to join a growing independent wealth management firm managing approximately $2.5 billion in client assets, based in downtown Chicago.

This is a unique opportunity for an advisor who wants to step into meaningful client relationships without needing to bring a portable book of business. With several senior partners approaching retirement, the firm has a significant pipeline of established relationships ready to transition to the next generation of advisors. The incoming advisor will inherit and manage these relationships while building a long-term practice through referrals and new business development.

This position offers a legitimate succession opportunity, full planning and investment support, and a clear runway to build a lasting practice within an established, well-regarded platform.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as lead advisor and primary relationship manager for affluent and high-net-worth clients.
  • Assume responsibility for established client relationships transitioned from senior advisors.
  • Develop and deliver comprehensive financial planning and wealth management strategies.
  • Advise clients across retirement, investment, tax, estate, and broader wealth planning needs.
  • Coordinate with the firm's planning, research, investment, trading, and client service professionals.
  • Identify opportunities to deepen existing client relationships.
  • Generate referrals and develop new client relationships over time.
  • Collaborate with senior advisors during the handoff and transition of client relationships.
  • Deliver a highly personalized client experience while maintaining the firm's planning-focused approach.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of wealth management, financial advisory, or private wealth experience.
  • Demonstrated ability to independently manage affluent and high-net-worth client relationships.
  • Strong financial planning and relationship management background.
  • Comfortable presenting recommendations and leading client meetings.
  • Strong communication and interpersonal skills, with the desire to eventually originate new business.
  • CFP designation required.
  • Series 7/65/66 or comparable licensing preferred.
  • Portable assets welcomed but not required.

Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience, including salary plus a comprehensive benefits package. This role is based in the firm's downtown Chicago office, however, satellite offices are available around the Chicagoland area.

title: Wealth Advisor
html:
We have an opportunity for a relationship-driven, thoughtful Wealth Advisor to join a boutique independent RIA with a deliberately managed, high-trust client base.

This role is designed for an advisor who values depth over volume, proactive planning over reactive service, and wants to build long-term client relationships without the pressure of business development.

This is a non-sales role within a highly collaborative firm that screens aggressively for client fit and prioritizes trust, transparency, and real-world advocacy. The right advisor will step into an established planning environment with meaningful client interaction, strong internal support, and room to grow alongside senior partners.


DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Serve as a primary or secondary advisor to clients, delivering comprehensive financial advice across planning, investments, and tax-aware strategies

  • Prepare for and participate in client meetings, including agenda development, plan updates, and follow-up execution

  • Collaborate closely with senior advisors on financial plan construction, recommendations, and ongoing refinement

  • Provide proactive client support, including:

    • Tax planning coordination and preparation workflows

    • Medicare eligibility reviews, open enrollment support, and plan comparisons

    • Real-world guidance clients rely on beyond traditional portfolio management

  • Ensure accurate documentation, task tracking, and follow-through within the firm’s CRM and planning systems

  • Contribute to continuous improvement of planning workflows, client experience, and service cadence

  • Maintain a service-first mindset focused on long-term relationships, accountability, and client advocacy

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5-10 years experience as a Wealth Advisor, Associate Advisor, or similar client-facing planning role

  • CFP certification strongly preferred, or active progress toward CFP with commitment to completion

  • Planning-oriented mindset with interest in holistic financial advice (not product-driven or sales-focused)

  • Strong interpersonal and communication skills; comfortable engaging with clients by phone, video, and in person

  • Highly organized, detail-oriented, and accountable; able to manage multiple client priorities simultaneously

  • Collaborative, humble, and comfortable in a “pitch-in” environment where no task is beneath anyone

  • Interest in building a long-term career within a small, values-driven advisory firm

title: Wealth Advisor
html:
We are seeking a Wealth Advisor to join the Washington, DC team of a nationally recognized, rapidly growing independent RIA. This role is built for a hungry, relationship-driven CFP professional who wants to grow a practice with the full backing of a collaborative team, a deep firm platform, and leadership that shows up alongside you.

You'll start with a set of existing client relationships so you're advising from day one, then focus on building your practice with clients in the $1–5 million range with support from your leadership team. You'll get access to the firm's established network of centers of influence (CPAs, attorneys, etc), plus a dedicated business development representative for the DC market.
It's an opportunity to build something of your own, with real upside, at a firm that has recently secured new growth capital and is investing heavily in advisor growth, lead generation, and the DC market.

This is a hybrid role, with new hires working primarily in the office until acclimated to the team.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Drive new client growth through referrals, existing centers of influence, community involvement, professional and alumni networks, and events aligned with your interests.
  • Build and maintain strong, long-term client relationships, serving as a trusted advisor to families and individuals.
  • Deliver comprehensive wealth planning across all aspects of a family's financial well-being, including financial planning and budgeting, holistic balance sheet advice (cash and debt), asset allocation and investments, estate and tax planning, insurance analysis and review, and charitable strategy.
  • Apply strong knowledge of capital markets and asset allocation to guide client decisions.
  • Present confidently and persuasively to prospective clients and win their trust.
  • Collaborate with team members to develop best practices for building and maintaining strong client relationships.
  • Maintain high standards of professionalism, detail, and organization across client and internal work.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 5+ years of experience as a client-facing wealth advisor.
  • CFP designation required (exceptional candidates holding a CPA, CFA, or JD may be considered).
  • Series 65 required, or obtained within 90 days of hire.
  • Bachelor's degree required.
  • Demonstrated business development drive and a track record of growing client relationships.
  • Polished, confident presence with prospective and high-net-worth clients.
  • RIA experience preferred; candidates from wirehouses, banks, trust companies, and other channels are welcome.
  • Experience with financial planning software (MoneyGuide or eMoney).
  • Expertise with law firm compensation structures is a strong plus; experience serving physicians or deep insurance knowledge is also valued.
  • Team-oriented, high-integrity, curious, and coachable, with excellent written and verbal communication skills.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Base salary of $175,000–$200,000, commensurate with experience, with a compensation model built on a competitive percentage of revenue served as your practice grows, and a likely new business incentive component. Equity participation opportunities may also be available. Benefits include medical, dental, vision, and life insurance for eligible employees and dependents, 401(k) with employer match, short- and long-term disability, education assistance, flexible time off, and 13 paid holidays.

title: Wealth Advisor
html:
We are seeking a Wealth Advisor to join a rapidly growing, high-performance wealth management firm supporting clients in the $1M+ range. This role blends financial planning, relationship management, and business development, with access to firm-generated leads and a clear path for long-term growth.

The ideal candidate is driven, coachable, and thrives in an environment built on accountability, continuous improvement, and results. This is a strong fit for someone early in their advisory career who wants mentorship, structure, and the opportunity to scale quickly within a growth-focused platform.

This position offers the opportunity to step into an active client pipeline, contribute to firm expansion, and develop into a high-producing advisor within a team-oriented environment.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Establish and develop new client relationships through firm-generated leads, referral channels, and internal business development efforts.
  • Deliver comprehensive financial planning and investment guidance to a defined client base, primarily within the high-net-worth segment.
  • Partner with senior advisors and leadership to support client strategy, planning, and ongoing relationship management.
  • Participate in seminars, educational events, and marketing initiatives designed to drive client acquisition and engagement.
  • Collaborate with internal teams to ensure a seamless client experience from prospecting through onboarding and ongoing service.
  • Maintain consistent follow-up and communication with prospects and clients, building trust and long-term relationships.
  • Stay current on financial markets, planning strategies, and industry trends while adhering to firm and regulatory standards.
  • Engage in ongoing training, mentorship, and professional development opportunities.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • Bachelor’s degree in business, finance, economics, or related field preferred.
  • 3–5 years of experience in financial planning, investment advisory, or wealth management.
  • FINRA licensing required (Series 65 or 7/66); CFP preferred or in progress.
  • Experience working with high-net-worth clients strongly preferred.
  • Strong communication and relationship-building skills with the ability to engage clients confidently.
  • Highly motivated, self-directed, and comfortable in a performance-driven environment.
  • Strong organizational and time management skills with attention to detail.
  • Willingness to work in-office full-time and actively engage in a collaborative team setting.

Compensation includes a base salary plus performance-based incentives tied to client acquisition, production, and growth. First-year total compensation ranges dependent upon experience, with significant upside in subsequent years based on performance.

title: Wealth Manager
html:
We are seeking an experienced Wealth Manager who is passionate about providing comprehensive financial planning and wealth management services while acting in the best interest of every client.

This position is ideal for an experienced financial professional who enjoys building lasting client relationships, leading meaningful financial planning conversations, and growing a book of business through referrals, prospecting, and community engagement.

This is an excellent opportunity to join a collaborative, fee-only fiduciary advisory firm where advisors work alongside experienced professionals to deliver comprehensive wealth management solutions.

This is a full-time, in-office position based in Appleton, Wisconsin.

DUTIES & RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Deliver comprehensive wealth management services by developing personalized financial strategies aligned with each client's goals, values, and objectives.
  • Lead the financial planning process through meaningful discovery conversations, identifying client priorities and creating customized planning recommendations.
  • Build and maintain long-term client relationships through ongoing review meetings, proactive communication, and exceptional service.
  • Grow the firm's client base through business development efforts, including prospecting, cultivating referral sources, and leveraging personal and professional networks.
  • Partner with internal advisors and subject matter experts to provide integrated wealth management solutions across investment, tax, estate, insurance, and retirement planning.
  • Maintain strong working relationships with internal teams while contributing to a collaborative and client-first culture.
  • Stay current on industry trends, financial planning strategies, and regulatory requirements through continuing education and professional development.
  • Mentor and support newer team members while promoting best practices and knowledge sharing across the advisory team.
  • Ensure adherence to all regulatory requirements, internal compliance policies, and ethical standards.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • CFP designation required.
  • Bachelor's degree in Finance, Business, Economics, or a related field required.
  • 5+ years of experience in a wealth advisory or financial planning role.
  • Strong understanding of investment management, portfolio construction, retirement planning, and comprehensive financial planning strategies.
  • Demonstrated success developing and maintaining trusted client relationships within a high-touch advisory environment.
  • Proven ability to generate referrals, retain client relationships, and contribute to organic asset growth.
  • Experience utilizing financial planning software, CRM platforms, and portfolio management technology such as Salesforce, Black Diamond/Orion, eMoney, Holistiplan, HubSpot, or similar systems.
  • Excellent communication and interpersonal skills with the ability to simplify complex financial concepts for clients.
  • Self-motivated, collaborative, and committed to delivering an exceptional fiduciary client experience.

COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

Compensation is competitive and commensurate with experience.

The firm offers a comprehensive benefits package that includes medical, dental, and vision insurance; life and disability coverage; paid time off; a 401(k) plan with employer contributions; professional development opportunities; summer hours; company-sponsored events; and a collaborative culture focused on employee growth, teamwork, and long-term success.
